GRIMPULSE.HandleHint: Drag to move. Double-click to reset the position.

Theme.Name: Colour theme
Theme.Hint: Same four themes as Grim Almanac. Each player picks their own.

Scale.Name: Size
Scale.Hint: Scale of the turn strip on your screen.

MaxTurns.Name: Turns shown
MaxTurns.Hint: How many upcoming turns the strip shows at once.

PlayerNumbers.Name: Exact HP and AC shown to players
PlayerNumbers.Hint: Everyone else is shown as a heartbeat line and blood stains only. The GM always sees the numbers.

ImageSource.Name: Picture used
ImageSource.Hint: Which image fills the turn frame.

RoundBanner.Name: Round banner
RoundBanner.Hint: Dim the screen and sweep the round number across it when a new round begins.

BannerRoundOne.Name: Round banner on round 1
BannerRoundOne.Hint: Leave this off if another module, such as Encounter FX, already announces the start of combat.

HideCoreTracker.Name: Hide Foundry's Combat Tracker from players
HideCoreTracker.Hint: Removes the Combat tab from the sidebar for players. The GM always keeps it.
